_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang unchanged at its tagged 0.53.0; beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.72.1 (the same code as 0.72.0, with a shorter What's new). beamlynx-ui 0.72.1 needs pine-lang 0.53 (its RequiredVersion).
